title: 🌳️ Dashboard command tree
description: 🎛️ The wizard command tree the dashboard discovers at boot: one node per wizard step, a leaf naming the registry command it starts or the repo-domain action the Rust domain crates answer in process. `semio command-tree --dump-tree` prints exactly this document.

CommandNode.description: 🌳️ One wizard step. A node without `children` is a leaf and carries a `leaf`.

key.description: 🔑️ The stable key the wizard path is built from; a project target is keyed `:<target>` under its owner.

children.description: 🌿️ The next wizard step: the verb at the root in launcher order, then the owner taxonomy of the command, sorted alphabetically.

CommandLeaf.description: 🍃️ What activating the leaf starts: a registry command or a repo-domain operation.

InvocationLeaf.description: ▶️ A registry command and the parameters the row pins. Resolving it to a launch is the registry's business (`semio run <id> --dry-run`); the tree starts nothing itself.

parameters.description: 🎛️ `[parameter id, value]` pairs: a playground row pins its renderer.

RepoLeaf.description: 🦑️ A repo-domain operation the Rust domain crates answer in process; `goArgv` states the same operation for the Go implementation, which `SEMIO_REPO_IMPLEMENTATION=go` spawns instead.

action.description: 🔑️ The action key: a bare name, or `<name>:<argument>` for a ticket or an analysis scope.
